about_the_game:
Your voice is your weapon. Your faith is your shield.

Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror game where every encounter, every battle, and every ritual is performed through your own voice. Equipped with sacred verses, chants, and rites, you’ll speak directly into your microphone to repel, stun, or banish the demonic presence haunting the possessed.

As a young priest sent to verify a suspected possession, you’ll explore a photorealistic, lived-in home transformed into a battlefield between the mortal and the damned. The entity will stalk, taunt, and attack. Reacting to your words, your timing, and even your hesitation.


Your courage and conviction are tested in real time. Mispronounce, falter, or lose focus, and the demon will strike without mercy.

Features:

  • Voice-driven combat & rituals – Use your microphone as your primary tool to interact, defend, and exorcise.

  • Reactive Enemies – The demons listen, learns, and punishes mistakes.

  • Photorealistic atmosphere – Explore a tense, realistic setting that constantly shifts under supernatural influence.

  • Constant tension – No scripted safe zones, danger can come at any time.

Faith is not passive. In Spiritus Sancti, you fight with it.

content_descriptors.notes:
Spiritus Sancti is a survival horror game with themes and imagery intended for mature audiences. The game contains:

Intense scenes of supernatural violence and psychological horror (e.g., levitations, physical aggression by possessed characters, disturbing transformations).

Frequent graphic depictions of gore (blood, injuries, mutilation, and unsettling imagery in paintings and environments).

Disturbing thematic elements including demonic possession, exorcisms, and characters in states of torment or suffering.

Strong language and aggressive dialogue used by possessed characters.
